concept.title: Adjusting steering wheel angle and height

li.p: To change the steering wheel angle, pull down the lock release lever (1).
Adjust the steering wheel to the desired angle and distance forward/back (2) and desired angle (3).
Move the steering wheel, so it points toward your chest, not toward your face. Make sure you can see the instrument panel warning lights and gauges. After adjusting, pull up the lock.
Pull up the lock-release lever to lock the steering wheel in place.
Push the steering wheel both up and down to be certain it is locked in position.
Be sure to adjust the steering wheel to the desired position before driving.

note.p: After adjustment, sometimes the lock-release lever may not lock the steering wheel.
It is not a malfunction. This occurs when two gears engage. In this case, adjust the steering wheel again and then lock the steering wheel.

li.p: Never adjust the position of the steering wheel while driving.
While adjusting the steering wheel height, please do not push or pull it hard since the fixture can be damaged.
